about_the_game:
Discover the Maldives, the ultimate destination for pilots seeking a well-deserved break in an incomparably breathtaking and enchantingly beautiful landscape. Imagine relaxing on pristine white sandy beaches and gazing out over the crystal-clear turquoise waters of the Indian Ocean after a long flight.

Enjoy luxurious over-water villas, vibrant coral reefs teeming with marine life and world-class diving and snorkeling.

Or are you one of the barefoot pilots in their DHC Twin Otters, flying countless VIP tourists to their luxury resorts every day? Then take off from the largest seaplane base in the world and dock at the small jetties of the many resorts!

Whether you are looking for relaxation, adventure or romance, the Maldives offers the perfect idyllic retreat where every moment feels like a dream come true.

Features:

  • Complete and extremely detailed recreation of Velana International Airport Malé (VRMM)

  • Incredibly detailed representation of the seaplane base with typical DHC Twin Otter seaplanes

  • New (not yet opened) terminal

  • Capital island of Hulhumalé (still under construction)

  • Malé island and several other islands around the airport

  • X-Plane 12 technologies (dynamic lights, reflective textures, water textures and more)

  • Compatible with all known add-ons

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core or AMD Ryzen CPU with at least 4 cores
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.3-capable graphics card (AMD/ Nvidia) with at least 6 GB VRAM (8+ GB recommended)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD highly recommended
